grade_reason: Grade A. U = 0: every rate is published by the Water Authority, the statutory period is defined in regulation, the billing formula is established from the publisher's own two worked examples and reproduced exactly by the engine, and the absence of any standing charge is confirmed rather than assumed. Nothing in the bill is uncertain.

reference_connection.size: Domestic metered service — no connection-size parameter
reference_connection.designation: WSD prices domestic fresh water purely by volume across four tiers and enumerates the whole of what a domestic bill can carry. No standing charge, meter rent or size band appears anywhere in the domestic tariff, so there is no connection size to designate.

billing_formula.tier_proration: each tier volume is scaled by actual reading days ÷ 121.64
billing_formula.volume_rounding: the prorated tier volume is rounded to three decimals before multiplying
billing_formula.line_rounding: the line amount is truncated to cents, not rounded
billing_formula.evidence: Both stages are visible twice in WSD's published examples. Example 1's third tier of 19.837 m³ bills HK$127.94 rather than the 127.95 that 19.83722 would give; example 2's fourth tier bills HK$57.61 from 6.366 × 9.05 = 57.6123.

public_reconciliation.note: Two independent checks from the Water Authority's own worked examples, at two different reading intervals, without any private document. The pair is stronger than a single invoice: the same volume over 127 and 117 days must give different bills, and it does.

component_states.basis: WSD enumerates the entire content of a domestic bill — four water tiers plus sewage — and separately enumerates the only other items that can appear: odd cents carried between bills and a 5% surcharge on overdue bills. No standing charge exists to model.
Same enumeration. No meter rent appears in the domestic tariff.
No tax line appears in the enumeration of a domestic bill. Hong Kong levies no general consumption tax.

components.name: Water charge
components.rate_display: First 12 m³ free per four-month period, then HK$4.16, HK$6.45, HK$9.05

components.name: Sewage charge
components.rate_display: First 12 m³ exempt per four-month period, then HK$2.92/m³

excluded.reason: A penalty for late payment, not part of the cost of receiving water. Excluded under §8 with connection fees, deposits and penalties.
Applies to 27 named trades. Not a residential charge.
Sea water flushing is free; fresh water flushing is metered per building and billed to the management office, not to the household. It is not part of a domestic account.
Checked and does not apply: the concession is for non-domestic accounts only. Recorded because it was verified, not because it was assumed away.

scope_disclosures: Reference account is a separately metered domestic dwelling. A meter is installed at the supply pipe of each flat, so the household is the billing unit for fresh water.

The benchmark runs at the statutory period of exactly 121.64 days. A real bill covers whatever interval the meter reader produced, and the tiers prorate to it — which is why the same consumption gives a different bill over 127 days than over 117.
shape_note: Tiers reset every four months, so the free 12 m³ recurs about 3.0027 times a year rather than once. The standardized 180 m³/year becomes 59.947021 m³ per statutory period.

jurisdiction.note: City is a display layer. The observation belongs to jurisdiction x utility x service area x customer class x schedule x period.

continuity.note: WSD's own Water & Sewage Tariff page, captured 17 August 2026, publishes these rates as current and states that water charges have not been revised since 16 February 1995. A revision would be published on this page; the page is the supersession check. Thirty-one years of open-ended validity is what this rule exists to permit.
